title: Autoregressive Adversarial Post-Training for Real-Time Interactive Video Generation
tldr_zh: 对抗后训练把视频扩散模型改成1NFE/帧自回归生成器，单H100达24fps实时流式生成
tldr_en: Adversarial post-training turns video diffusion into 1NFE/frame autoregressive generator, 24fps real-time on one H100

key_numbers.context: Temporal Quality on 1440-frame VBench-I2V, best among compared methods
Frame Quality on 120-frame VBench-I2V, tied best with Wan 2.1
Dynamic Degree on 120-frame, down from 52.52 diffusion baseline
AKD on pose-conditioned human generation, second only to OmniHuman-1 (2.136)
FVD on camera-conditioned world exploration, new SOTA
average shot duration in training datasets
attention window size, 30 latent frames = 5 seconds
